notes.title: Digital Dungeon Tiles v2.0 - Extra
notes.content:
[h1]Digital Dungeon Tiles v2.0 - Extra[/h1]

We filled another request and added some cool new stuff! The request to add a "Roll20 / Online" image quality export has been added. Just use the F9 button while in play mode.

We have added some cool new dice to help solo players and random players enjoy the game more by letting them roll for enemy actions using 8 new dice!

10 new Tile textures have been added at no extra cost, with more to come! Also some visual feedback have been added when selecting and moving tokens.

A commercial License is on the way for anyone looking to export and sell the maps they make in Digital Dungeon Tiles. That DLC should be releasing soon, we will release more info at that time.

[h3]New Dice Type[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skulls & Shields (Used for easy attack and defend rolls)
[*] Alpha (Rolls letters of the Alphabet)
[*] Battle (Random Battle Actions)
[*] Chance (Easy Skill checks)
[*] Facing (Directional Rolls)
[*] Event (Random Events like traps, loot, quests, etc)
[*] Math (Random Math Symbols)
[*] React (Random NPC / Monster personal reactions to the Players or eachother)
[/list]


[h2]New[/h2]

[list]
[*] 8 New Dice to assist Solo or Random Play
[*] 10 New Tile Textures
[*] Web Play Quality Map Image Export Added (Use F9 in play mode)
[*] Token Selection and Movement Feedback VFX
[*] Commercial License Added (DLC Coming Soon)
[/list]

[h2]Updated[/h2]

[list]
[*] Map Image Export no longer export the play area icons for the GUI
[*] All Tile Textures adjusted to have more vibrant color
[/list]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37264068/874a0c7a2396ee96c657d1aede98aa1b3fc6a4c4.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37264068/571cf38bdc853fe0c900c65f2b56bac22cf3d71d.png[/img]

notes.title: Digital Dungeon Tiles Patch v1.8 - Initiative System
notes.content:
[h1]Digital Dungeon Tiles patch v1.8 - Initiative System[/h1]

We had fun with this patch, adding more features is always a great time! We have added an Initiative System to help track turns.. because even when playing with 3D printed miniatures, paper character sheets and real dice.. no one likes to track initiative!

So let us track initiative for you!

[list]
[*] Give your tokens a unique name
[*] Click the "add to Initiative" button
[*] Play!
[/list]

The tokens can make their turn as done, delay until the end of the turn, be added and removed at any time. AND.. clicking an image in the initiative bar pings the token on the map! (Tokens are also auto pinged at the start of their turns). You can also clear initiative and start fresh when ever you need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37264068/fa956ee45f4e08fcb13add7e823102101839b125.jpg[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37264068/a150ae7953a54433b629ce42c7a087424b5bf3c2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.7 - Dicey Dice
notes.content:
[h1]Update v1.7[/h1]

[h2]New[/h2]

[list]
[*] A simple Dice Roller as requested.
[/list]

The dice roller is contained within the token stats panel and when a dice is rolled it puts the results into a windows below it. Multiple of the same dice can be rolled at the same time with individual results being displayed, it also displays which token is doing the dice rolling.

You can clear and closed the dice roll results area if you want to reclaim the screen space.

[h3]Note:[/h3] Digital Dungeon Tiles is a mapping software first and foremost. These features we are adding to assist play are just bonus features, you should not expect them to be deeply intricate systems.

[h2]Updated[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed some placeable objects that were not playing nicely with the save and load system.
[*] Increased the performance of the lighting system when using multiple light sources.
[*] Fixed a monster token that was showing up as a blank token
[/list]

[h2]With Roll Results Showing:[/h2]

notes.title: A bug has been squished - Update v1.6
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.6[/h1]

When overwriting an existing file Digital Dungeon Tiles could add and an extra ".ddtm" or ".ddtt" extension to the file name, depending on if the file was a map or a token being saved.

Instead of generating a bug report, it generated a bad review, sorry for the bug.. but it's now resolved. if you find a bug, please reach out to us so we can fix it.

notes.title: v1.5 Day One Patch with Huge Added Features! [Token Stats]
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that a "Token Stats" system has been added to Digital Dungeon Tiles!

If you are playing using real miniatures or with the built in tokens you can now save and load stats on each token.

[h1]What are token Stats?[/h1]

Token Stats is a visual stats system available on each token while in play mode.  Stats can be hidden and shown as needed, on each token. This gives players access to quickly tracking HP and other important stats, to make playing easier. This works great with the token system and works with real miniatures by sitting tokens beneath them on the map.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37264068/ca2805793306d9ef882773352232871f954c09db.png[/img]


[h1]What Stats are stored on the Tokens?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Token Name
[*] Current Hit Points
[*] Maximum Hit Points
[*] Actions
[*] Status Effects
[*] Facing Direction
[*] Token Ownership
[/list]

[h1]Why wasn't this in the initial marketing?[/h1]

We weren't sure this extra feature would be complete and available for launch day... but it is!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37264068/af08cd2f194f64d9be8c4709e6c61591c5523ac9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37264068/d6380242983f39adc92bfded16a618edb7492bb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37264068/19b44946e9d9ae215cb9646e1df0b679c58f1816.png[/img]
